videos.title: Humans Can Regrow an Organ
videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:
Every month, the uterus builds an entire new layer of tissue, prepares it for a possible pregnancy, then starts all over again. Billions of people experience this cycle, yet there’s still a surprising amount we don’t understand about it.

videos.title: Your Skeleton Is Electric
videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:
Every step you take creates tiny electrical signals inside your bones. You’ll never charge your phone with them, but they may help tell your skeleton where it needs to grow stronger.
